source: メガトン第 7 居住甲板の改修用。ユーザーが別に生成した 1254x1254 の画像。1 枚の絵のマスは crop で余白 (白い背景や壁) を切り落とす
style: Bright, clean public streets of a huge rotating space habitat, mechanical but lived-in. Each cell is a flat, evenly lit, front-on or top-down surface with no perspective, no shadows and no readable text.

cells.name: mg-floor-main
cells.prompt: Main shopping street floor seen from directly above: light grey and beige stone pavers in a running bond, worn smooth, thin dark joints.

cells.name: mg-wall-main
cells.prompt: Street wall of shops: light cream glazed brick-like tiles in a stack bond with thin grout lines, slightly uneven glaze.

cells.name: mg-floor-market
cells.prompt: Market street floor from above: light grey sealed concrete with a stainless drain channel, faint water stains and scuffs.

cells.name: mg-wall-shop
cells.prompt: Shop interior wall: off-white painted panels with thin vertical joints and tiny screw heads, very clean.

cells.name: mg-floor-civic
cells.prompt: Civic plaza and ward office floor from above: large pale stone tiles (60 cm) with thin joints and a subtle polished sheen.

cells.name: mg-wall-civic
cells.prompt: Ward office / school wall: white acoustic wall panels with a fine perforated pattern and slim aluminium joints.

cells.name: mg-ceil-panel
cells.prompt: Corridor ceiling seen from below: white square ceiling panels with a small access hatch and slim metal grid lines.

cells.name: mg-ceil-pipes
cells.prompt: Alley ceiling seen from below: light grey painted steel deck with exposed pipes, cable bundles and brackets running across it.

cells.name: mg-frame
cells.prompt: Painted structural steel I-beam surface: off-white paint over steel with rivets, small dents and a few scuffs at the edges.
